Mitch Anderson (director) | Mitch Anderson is a Romanian-born American film director, producer, writer, researcher and editor.  He is the only son of former political dissidents of the Stalinist era.  His first film, "The World Without US", explores what might happen if the United States were to leave the international arena, rescind its global reach and return to being a non-interventionist nation.
